description: Keyword-search a registry's full dataflow catalogue by id or name substring. Use this to find the dataflow id to pass to sdmx_dataflow_structure when you only know a topic. Example: sdmx_find_dataflow({ registry: "bis", query: "credit" }) or sdmx_find_dataflow({ registry: "oecd", query: "unemployment" }). For Eurostat specifically, the eurostat pack's own search_datasets tool searches its ~10,000-entry table of contents with richer metadata (last-update dates, time coverage) and is usually the better choice.

agency.description: Restrict to one maintaining agency id instead of the registry default, e.g. "OECD.SDD.NAD".

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against dataflow id or name, e.g. "unemployment", "credit", "exchange rate".

registry.description: Which SDMX registry to query: eurostat, oecd, ecb, unsd, imf, bis, ilo, abs.

name: sdmx_find_dataflow
title: Sdmx Find Dataflow
